# @sharadox/turborepo-configuration-web-library

> Writes turbo.json for a project kind (Turborepo can't extend a config from a package in single-package repos).

- Command: `turborepo-configuration <library|next-js-application|node>` writes ./turbo.json; run it in package.json "prepare" and gitignore turbo.json.
- library: format:check, lint, type-check, test:unit (outputs coverage/), test:benchmark (no cache), documentation, build (source/ → distribution/).
- next-js-application: same checks on src/, build (.next/, env NEXT_PUBLIC_*), test:end-to-end (dependsOn build), development/start (persistent).
- node: checks only.
- All: remoteCache.signature true (TURBO_TOKEN, TURBO_TEAM, TURBO_REMOTE_CACHE_SIGNATURE_KEY).
- API: turborepoConfiguration(kind), PROJECT_KINDS, runCommand(args, { writeFile, print }).
- Licence: Sharadox Open Source Licence 0.1.0
